content.title: Mixed Real Estate Complex with 202 Free Promotional Housing
summary: A five-block mixed-use complex in Said Hamdine, combining 202 homes on a steeply sloping site with one basement parking level and three commercial levels with mezzanines.
Said Hamdine combines housing, commerce, and parking into one compact urban scheme, carefully fitted to a steeply sloping site.
description: The project comprises five residential blocks, 202 free promotional homes, three commercial levels with mezzanines, and one basement parking level on a steeply sloping Algerian site.
Igloo coordinated the full TCE delivery, with particular attention to façade design, balconies, glazed surfaces, parking access, and the sequencing of mixed-use volumes.
content.authority: A mixed-use urban complex unified by its structure, access, housing, and rigorous execution.
